detail.title: General Preference Oracles in RLHF without Explicit Reward Functions
detail.summary: Investigation of reverse-KL regularized minimax games between LLMs under general preference oracles, showing how relative feedback frameworks bypass rigid reward functions.
detail.reason: Synthesizing collected literature on general preference oracles and RLHF formulations for project proj-emergent-prefs-01.
